newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat down on harvest weather.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat down on harvest weather.

text.p: Argentine wheat eased in good volume cash market trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with sunny harvest weather and end-of-month technical sales of speculative positions, traders said.

March cash wheat retreated $3 to $134. Cash maize was steady, with April holding firm at $98 in tight trade. There was fair demand from exporters to take positions, but offers were a dollar or two higher. Cash soybeans were steady to firmer, despite an easier Chicago market. Prices were squeezed up by limited supply, although crop conditions are fairly good. Cash sunflower seed was unchanged, with March at $214.
